PDF Accurate Volume Rendering based on Adaptive Numerical Integration
Abstract—We present an adaptive integration strategy to evaluate the volume rendering integral for regular volumes. We discuss different strategies to control the step size for both the inner and the outer integrals in the volume rendering equation.
